```python
def radix_sort(arr):
    RADIX = 10
    exp = 1
    while (max(arr) // exp) > 0:
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(RADIX)]
        for i in arr:
            temp = i / exp
            buckets[int(temp % RADIX)].append(i)
        j = 0
        for b in buckets:
            buckets[b].sort()
            for ele in buckets[b]:
                buckets[j].append(ele)
                j += 1
        arr = buckets[j]
        exp *= RADIX
    return arr
```
